scope: Official-source feasibility constraints for branded content -> social discovery/share -> owned utility -> consented personalization -> repeat sharing.

findings.finding: TikTok provides Share Kit and Content Posting API paths for sharing/publishing app-created content, subject to integration setup, review and platform limits.

TikTok Content Sharing Guidelines state that apps/integrations should not superimpose brand names, logos, watermarks, promotional links or promotional text on content shared to TikTok. Therefore the defense layer must not assume a visible promotional watermark survives or is permitted on TikTok-shared content.
TikTok Direct Post guidance is intended for authentic creators posting original content and explicitly rejects arbitrary copying from other platforms as an intended integration use.

TikTok requires URL ownership verification for relevant app configuration and some link/content-posting features; Android redirects use App Link/Deep Link and iOS redirects use Universal Link in documented registration flows.
Apple requires App Tracking Transparency authorization when app-related data is used to track users across other companies' apps or websites.

Apple review guidance prohibits surreptitious user profiling and requires explicit permission for tracking; data collected for one purpose cannot simply be repurposed without further consent unless otherwise permitted.
Google Play requires personal/sensitive data access, collection, use and sharing to be limited to purposes reasonably expected by the user and consistent with app functionality and policy.

design_implications: Do not make visible watermarking the core anti-copy mechanism for TikTok integration.
Prefer distinctive creative format, account identity, audio/visual signature where policy-compliant, profile/deep-link paths, owned utility and saved state as the return-path moat.
Treat cross-app/web behavioral targeting as permission-gated rather than invisible by default.
First-party in-product context can power useful recommendations, but purpose and controls should be understandable to the user.
The clean three-engine model remains feasible as a hypothesis, but exact Instagram/Meta sharing/deep-link constraints still require a separate fresh official-source pass before implementation.
No evidence in this packet establishes conversion uplift, retention uplift, willingness to pay, repost-to-source return rate, or cross-domain portability; those remain experiment hypotheses.
next_autonomous_research: Build a platform-neutral return-path design that does not depend on promotional watermarks.
Define measurable funnel events from social discovery to owned utility to repeat share.
Define clean personalization tiers: contextual, first-party history, permission-gated cross-context.
Compare recipe, fitness, travel, language, beauty/style, DIY, productivity and hobby education using repeat intent, shareability, exclusive utility, monetization and platform dependence.
Research Meta/Instagram official constraints separately before any implementation claim.
